summary: Seven measurement defects an audit found: the judge was replaying one cached answer, the gate suite passed a gate that was 100% wrong, and four architecture gates passed against no-op production code.
details: All of the same kind — the instrument was not measuring what it claimed.
The judge's majority-of-k was three replays of one cached answer, because temperature 0 is what makes request bytes repeat.
The relevance-gate suite computed accuracy and coverage and then never consulted them.
The media-egress screen could be replaced with a no-op, the media join's result discarded, and a truncation check deleted with the word left in a log line, all with green tests.
The no-trigger corpus was authored for a trigger no deployment runs, and four of its twelve near-misses actually tagged.
